receiving.title.where: Receive gift dialog, once the gift's preview names the giver: the dialog's name for assistive tech and LINE's header while it's open

receiving.title_unknownGiver.where: Receive gift dialog, while the preview is loading or when a refusal came without the giver: the dialog's name and LINE's header

receiving.gift.title.where: Receive gift dialog, sealed bag through the reveal: the heading beside the giver's picture
receiving.gift.title.ja: {{name}}さんからシールが届きました

receiving.gift.pullTabHint.where: Receive gift dialog, sealed bag: the two-line hint under the bag, the pull tab first, then the other ways to open it; it fades as the sticker rises
receiving.gift.pullTabHint.ja: つまみを引いてひらいてくださいダブルタップや長押しでもひらけます

receiving.gift.acceptSheet.where: Receive gift dialog, once the pull tab snaps and the sticker rises: the Accept sheet's name for assistive tech, also read in its perforation's Close name
receiving.gift.acceptSheet.ja: このシールを受け取る

receiving.gift.forYou.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet: the first line, naming the person opening the gift in bold

receiving.gift.finePrint.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet: the fine print under the first line, with the sticker's number, drawing time, seal day and Original Artist

receiving.gift.notReceived.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet, after tapping Accept fails: the alert above Accept, with the reason
receiving.gift.notReceived.ja: {{no}}を受け取れませんでした。{{reason}}「受け取る」をタップして、もう一度お試しください。

receiving.gift.accept.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet: the main key, which receives the sticker

receiving.gift.accepting.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet, after tapping Accept: the key's label while the sticker is being received

receiving.gift.notNow.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet: the quiet link under Accept that closes the dialog without receiving

receiving.termsLine.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet: the small line at the bottom, naming the giver, with links to the Terms and Privacy Policy pages
receiving.termsLine.ja: 受け取ると、あなたのLINEの名前とプロフィール画像が<name/>さんに表示されます。<terms>利用規約</terms>と<privacy>プライバシーポリシー</privacy>に同意したものとみなされます。

receiving.refusals.groupChat.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift message was opened in a group chat: the title
receiving.refusals.groupChat.title.ja: {{name}}さんとのトークでひらいてください

receiving.refusals.groupChat.title_unkno.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift message was opened in a group chat and the refusal came without the giver: the title
receiving.refusals.groupChat.title_unkno.ja: 贈り主とのトークでひらいてください

receiving.refusals.groupChat.line.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift message was opened in a group chat: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.groupChat.line.ja: ギフトは、送られた1対1のトークでしかひらけません。{{name}}さんからあなたに届いたギフトなら、そちらでひらいてください。

receiving.refusals.groupChat.line_unknow.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift message was opened in a group chat and the refusal came without the giver: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.groupChat.line_unknow.ja: ギフトは、送られた1対1のトークでしかひらけません。贈り主からあなたに届いたギフトなら、そちらでひらいてください。

receiving.refusals.alreadyReceived.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift was already received: the title, over the open, empty bag

receiving.refusals.alreadyReceived.line.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift was already received: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.alreadyReceived.line.ja: ギフトメッセージをひらけるのは一度だけです。あなたがひらいたなら、シールはシールボードにあります。

receiving.refusals.ownGift.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when the giver opens their own gift message: the title
receiving.refusals.ownGift.title.ja: このギフトはお届け中です

receiving.refusals.ownGift.line.where: Gift refusal screen, when the giver opens their own gift message: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.ownGift.line.ja: ひらけるのは、贈った友だちだけです。

receiving.refusals.takenBack.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when the giver took the gift back before anyone received it: the title
receiving.refusals.takenBack.title.ja: {{name}}さんがこのギフトを取り消しました

receiving.refusals.takenBack.title_unkno.where: Gift refusal screen, when the giver took the gift back and the refusal came without the giver: the title
receiving.refusals.takenBack.title_unkno.ja: 贈り主がこのギフトを取り消しました

receiving.refusals.takenBack.line.where: Gift refusal screen, when the giver took the gift back before anyone received it: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.takenBack.line.ja: だれかが受け取る前に、シールは贈り主のシールボードに戻りました。

receiving.refusals.giftReturned.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift was returned or expired unopened: the title
receiving.refusals.giftReturned.title.ja: このギフトは{{name}}さんに戻りました

receiving.refusals.giftReturned.title_un.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift was returned or expired and the refusal came without the giver: the title
receiving.refusals.giftReturned.title_un.ja: このギフトは贈り主に戻りました

receiving.refusals.giftReturned.line.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift was returned or expired unopened: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.giftReturned.line.ja: ギフトの受け取り期限は1週間です。期限内にひらかれなかったので、シールは贈り主のシールボードに戻りました。

receiving.refusals.notDeposited.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift hasn't reached the escrow yet: the title, above Try again

receiving.refusals.notDeposited.line.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift hasn't reached the escrow yet: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.notDeposited.line.ja: このギフトはまだお届け中です。数秒後にもう一度お試しください。

receiving.refusals.giftNotFound.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when the link's Gift Claim Token matches no gift: the title
receiving.refusals.giftNotFound.title.ja: このリンクではギフトをひらけません

receiving.refusals.giftNotFound.line.where: Gift refusal screen, when the link's Gift Claim Token matches no gift: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.giftNotFound.line.ja: トークのギフトメッセージから、もう一度ひらいてください。

receiving.refusals.needsServer.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when the app is running without its server: the title
receiving.refusals.needsServer.title.ja: ギフトはまだひらけません

receiving.refusals.needsServer.line.where: Gift refusal screen, when the app is running without its server: the line under the title
receiving.refusals.needsServer.line.ja: ギフトをひらくにはアプリのサーバーが必要ですが、まだ動いていません。

receiving.previewFailed.title.where: Gift refusal screen, when loading the gift's preview failed: the title, above Try again
receiving.previewFailed.title.ja: ギフトをひらけませんでした

receiving.previewFailed.withoutSticker.where: Gift refusal screen, when the preview says the gift can be received but has no sticker: the line under the title
receiving.previewFailed.withoutSticker.ja: ギフトのプレビューにシールが含まれていませんでした。

receiving.previewFailed.withoutRefusal.where: Gift refusal screen, when the preview says the gift can't be received but gives no reason: the line under the title
receiving.previewFailed.withoutRefusal.ja: ギフトを受け取れない理由が、プレビューに含まれていませんでした。

receiving.backToLine.where: Gift refusal screen, inside LINE's app: the button that closes LINE's window, or the quiet link under Try again

receiving.goToStickerBoard.where: Gift refusal screen: the button when the gift was already received or is your own, and the way out in place of Back to LINE outside LINE's app
receiving.goToStickerBoard.ja: 自分のシールボードへ

receiving.tryAgain.where: Gift refusal screen, when the gift is still on its way or its preview failed: the button that loads the gift again

receiving.sendGratitude.title.where: Send gratitude sheet, over the sticker board once a received sticker has stuck to it: the title beside the giver's picture, also the sheet's name

receiving.sendGratitude.line.where: Send gratitude sheet, when the giver isn't the sticker's Original Artist: the line under the title
receiving.sendGratitude.line.ja: {{name}}さんからのシールが、シールボードに貼られました。感謝に期限はありません。

receiving.sendGratitude.lineFromOriginal.where: Send gratitude sheet, when the giver is the sticker's Original Artist: the line under the title, with their drawing time
receiving.sendGratitude.lineFromOriginal.ja: シールボードに貼られました。<name/>さんが<duration/>でかいたシールです。感謝に期限はありません。

receiving.sendGratitude.send.where: Send gratitude sheet: the pink key that starts the Gratitude Mini-game for the giver

receiving.sendGratitude.later.where: Send gratitude sheet: the quiet link that closes the sheet without sending gratitude

ui.sheet.close.where: Every bottom sheet: the perforation's name for assistive tech, a button that closes the sheet when tapped or dragged down; label is the sheet's name

pages.terms.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet: where the terms line's Terms link goes, opened in LINE's in-app browser

pages.privacy.where: Receive gift dialog, Accept sheet: where the terms line's Privacy Policy link goes, opened in LINE's in-app browser
